lines: Just around the time that Onigumo Saburo and Gaku Shonosuke infiltrated Goshaー
Above my head were the cloudless blue sky and the scorching sun.
Summer was in full swing no matter where I looked.
The heat would become even harsher in the afternoon.
I had just left school after finishing training with Library.
Gosha Academy was on summer break.
The only people who would come to school in the middle of this brutal heat were diligent students like me who took their daily training seriously.
I actually just needed to catch up on my training that I had slacked on so I could hold my own better in battle.
Library had really put me through the wringer that morning as well.
Alright, I think it's about time I went home and got a nap under that AC.
A voice called out to me from behind.
I turned around to see Hebiko trotting out of the school building.
I came to a stop and waited for Hebiko to reach me.
It's summer break and you came to school?
Well isn't that admirable of you!
Hebiko's going home too. Hebiko was studying in the library with Yukikaze-chan.
I instinctively glanced around on guard.
It would be unbearable if I ran into my natural enemy even during summer break.
C'mon now. You're way too jumpy, Fuma-chan!
Well, Yukikaze-chan had something to do with Rinko-senpai, so she went to the dojo.
What a relief. I could breathe a little easier.
Aren't you a little too happy?
Hey! Let's head home together, Fuma-chan.
We started walking side by side.
But really Fuma-chan? You still have a thing with Yukikaze-chan?
You two went alone on a mission together the other day, right? So why don't you get along?
That was because I needed Yukikaze's strength while you guys had to stand guard in our absence.
If it had to be just one person, it would be Yukikaze-chan. She's crazy strong.
Just this afternoon she said something about wanting to have an all-out spar with Rinko-senpai.
A full-on clash between the Slasher and Lightning, huh. That dojo's about to be blown to bits.
Hebiko just can't keep up with those two.
Hebiko chuckled, making a face as if to say there was nothing she could do about them.
Recently, Hebiko had become so strong that she could buy time against the likes of Yomi Akitsu.
But even so, the abilities of the next-gen Taimanin aces, such as Yukikaze and Rinko-senpai, were nothing short of extraordinary.
Well, speaking of "extraordinary," so were their personalities though.
Hey, how was that mission by the way?
Not much to it really. I just went to Jyubei's place. You remember Kanzaki Jyubei, right?
Wow, Jyubei-chan. Haven't heard his name in a while. How was he?
He was the same as always. But that Jyubei, he provoked Yukikaze as soon as he met her.
Oh, so he made her angry. Jyubei-chan's got such a bad mouth. What then, what then?
Hebiko leaned forward. But her expression said she pretty much knew how the story would unfold.
She almost sent my whole plan up in smoke by trying to blow Jyubei's entire building apart before we could get the information out of him.
Ahahahahaha! That sounds like Yukikaze-chan! Was she all like this? "Thor's Hammer!!"
Hebiko delightedly clapped her hands together making pistol shapes with them.
Yep, exactly. She snaps too quick. Well, at least she stopped in the nick of time.
Recalling Yukikaze at that time made me breathe a sigh.
But she did stop, right? So Hebiko thinks you two are getting closer than before, Fuma-chan.
Seeing a puzzled look on my face, Hebiko let out another cackle.
Hebiko spoke up just as we were passing by Inageya.
Hey, wanna buy some ice cream?
Oh! Good call... ah, I can't. I'm flat broke.
Agaaiin? You always say that, Fuma-chan.
But you told me you just got your allowance, right?
Well you see, I used it to buy this ninja video game called "Sekironin."
You bought another game? And it's a ninja one? You're already a Taimanin, and you wanna be a ninja even in games?
It seemed difficult to understand for Hebiko, who was more of a reader than a gamer.
Games and reality are different. You've got game brain, that's no good, Hebiko.
Hebiko's more worried about your brain, Fuma-chan.
I'm fine. And the game's a blast to play, so I regret nothing. But...
I lost a bet to Sakura, so now she's got it all to herself. Man...
Just talking about it made my shoulders drop in dismay.
That's why I was even more broke than usual that day.
What's that about? You don't seem fine at all.
It's just one of those days.
Every day's one of those days for you, isn't it...?
Oh come on already, Fuma-chan, that part of you ne～ver grows up.
Hebiko will have ice cream, okay?
Lowering my head a little, I spoke timidly.
Ummm, Hebiko-san, I'd be incredibly glad if you wouldn't mind buying me an ice cream...
Nope. It wouldn't be good to spoil you, Fuma-chan.
Heartbroken, I slumped my shoulders and began to trudge away from the shop.
Yeah. Don't worry about me, go ahead and eat your ice cream alone, Hebiko.
It's not your fault even if I pass out from this heat because I couldn't eat ice cream. That's all on me.
See ya, Hebiko. This is where we part ways. Adios.
Mrrrngh, fine! Hebiko'll treat you then!! Are you happy now?!
Oh, really!? I always knew you were the kindest, Hebiko! You're practically a goddess!
Did you just call me a goddess? You're the worst actor ever! And "adios?" Really?
Hahaha... overdid it with the "adios," huh?
Hebiko had been glaring at me with a pouty look on her face, but then she suddenly let out a giggle.
Jeez, you really are hopeless, Fuma-chan.
We sat down on the bench in front of the shop.
It was Inageya's special ice cream.
It had been so long since I last had one.
It tastes better than usual, doesn't it? Is it because it's hot out? No, it feels like it's got more crunchiness.
What made Inageya's ice cream so special was its delectable vanilla flavor, which was rich but not too heavy.
But on this day it had a sherbet-like freshness added to it.
Oh, this? It's the new summer version that came out this year.
Wha-!? A new version?? I didn't hear anything about it.
What's the point of telling someone broke like you? It went on sale a little bit ago.
Hebiko giggled and took another bite of the new Inageya ice cream with a satisfying crunch.
I took another bite as well to savor the new taste.
It tasted refreshingly light compared to the original, perfect for the summer season.
Just what I'd expect from Inageya. Even though their ice cream is already delicious, they still keep trying to improve.
The ice cream was so good that we even forgot to talk.
Since we were eating outside, the sun was beating down on us, but I felt it only made the ice cream taste even better.
It's been a while since you and Hebiko were together like this.
Hebiko gave a nod and stuck the ice cream in her mouth.
I took another bite as well.
Only the buzzing sounds of the cicadas could be heard.
The scorching sunlight, the reflected heat from the asphalt.
I could feel that heat on my skin.
Hebiko nodded and began swinging her legs from the bench.
She suddenly said this while looking at the ground.
Hebiko stopped swinging her legs and glared at me.
You don't have anything to do, do you, Fuma-chan?
For some reason, she spoke as if she'd been angered.
How come you know I don't have anything to do? Well, not that you're wrong about it, though.
Hebiko pouted her lips and spoke in a curt tone.
It's nothing but a hassle to go shopping for clothes with a girl. I would have to wait while she took forever to try them on and even get asked what I thought of them.
Well, at least I'd heard that was the case. I hadn't actually experienced it, though.
Why don't you go with Yukikaze? I don't really know anything about girls' clothes.
But Hebiko always goes shopping with Yukikaze-chan.
Sakura-chan can't really go outside with Hebiko, can she?
Then have her hide in your shadow.
Going out like that isn't fun.
Hebiko knows you don't have any taste in clothes, but sometimes Hebiko wants a change of pace.
It doesn't matter! So you don't wanna come? Then give my ice cream back!
Hebiko shoved her hand out toward me.
Then pay Hebiko back. Right now!
You know you have no hope for that, right?
Hebiko will tell Tokiko-san that you made Hebiko treat you to ice cream.
Fine! I'll go! But we're stopping by the arcade in exchange.
I thought for sure I'd be told, "More games?" but Hebiko nodded with a sweet smile.
We're just gonna buy some clothes, aren't we?
Clothes to go shopping are important, too.
Her threatening attitude up until that point was suddenly cheerful, as if it always had been.
Hebiko finished eating her remaining ice cream in one go.
Ice cream at Inageya tastes awesome even in the dead of winter, but nothing beats mid-summer ice cream huh.
Hebiko was looking at me with a curious expression when I gave the response.
Nothing. Hebiko was just wondering why she wants you to come with her so badly. It's not like you've got any style or anything.
The hell's with that!? Why are you taking shots at me all of a sudden!?
This time Hebiko burst into laughter.
Hebiko will call you when the shopping day's decided♪
I didn't know what exactly that was about, but I ended up making a promise to go clothes shopping with Hebiko.
Meanwhile, in the mountains behind Gosha Academyー
The ground suddenly rose up as if something was bubbling to the surface.
The figures that appeared from within the earth were Onigumo Saburo and the gigantic spider that she controlled.
Despite the fact that Saburo had burrowed through soil, her body wasn't the least bit dirty.
Tapped on the back of the neck by Saburo, the demonic spider began sniffing for scents.
Though there was no risk of being discovered while they were underground, Daigoro couldn't trace those "scents" while under there, either.
Saburo had dared to appear above ground so that Daigoro could track them.
The demonic spider made a strange growling sound, and Saburo nodded her head in agreement.
Just as they were about to make their next move...
Several Taimanin had appeared from the opposite side of the path and, surprised to see Saburo, rushed to surround her.
The unfazed Saburo murmured, almost silently.
They must have been patrolling this area by chance.
Otherwise, they never would have been able to find Saburo so quickly, who'd been traveling beneath the ground.
Can't you tell from this giant spider? And you call yourself a Taimanin?
A giant spider? I see... So you're the earth spider user from the traitor Nisha. But I've heard they were quite old.
Damn! So you're the brat of that earth spider user!
One of the Taimanin blurted out.
I'm not here to fight today. Leave, and I'll let you off the hook.
Remembering that she had been told to avoid combat, Saburo instructed Daigoro to burrow again.
Once she went underground, they wouldn't be able to come after her.
Laughable. What can a brat like you do!?
I heard that old gizzard was a real master, but in the end he's a relic of the past. Don't get too full of yourself on Gosha grounds, you little bitch.
The words of the Taimanin triggered something in Saburo.
As the 18th descendant in the Onigumo Saburo line, she couldn't let such an insult slide.
